summary.analyst:
Event: powershell was invoked with an obfuscated command consistent with probable-malicious activity. Recovered payload reads: `Get-Process | Format-Table`, which corroborates that powershell was used as a launcher for downstream code rather than a routine administrative task.

Living-off-the-land use of powershell bypasses application-allowlisting because the binary itself is signed and trusted; the malicious intent lives in the arguments, not the executable. Investigation mapped the observed behaviour to T1059.001 · PowerShell, T1027.010 · Command Obfuscation: Base64/Encoded Command, T1057 · Process Discovery.

Supporting evidence, in weight order: internal decoder step [N-002]; LOLBAS · powershell.exe [META-lolbas-001]; LOLBIN · powershell [N-006]; PowerShell [N-003]; Command Obfuscation: Encoded Command [N-004].

Impact is probable-malicious. The behaviour is inconsistent with routine administrative activity and warrants verification before containment is relaxed.

No containment signal was observed in the submitted evidence (no quarantine, block, or prevent action was reported). This does not mean containment did not occur — it means the artefact submitted to NivXRay did not include that telemetry.

Recommended next actions: 1. Investigate the recovered indicators in threat-intel and correlate against your environment.
